=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/alert_self_fix.sh:447-456 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: In `_asf_compose_body` `clean()`, the control-character strip `re.sub(r"[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]", "", text)` runs after the URL defang, so input such as `https:\x00//example.com/<owner>/<repo>/issues/9` (or `closes https:\u0000//github.com/owner/repo/issues/123`) escapes the defang and turns back into a linkable auto-close URL once the control character is stripped.
  WHY: The PR body can then carry a working auto-close reference to a non-tracking issue, which the lint does not block, and `gh pr merge --auto --squash` makes GitHub close that issue. Severities disagree: openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR (mapped to high) and minimax_minimax-m3 rated it NIT (mapped to low); the highest is kept. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same issue only as a hardening suggestion and called it defense-in-depth, because `alert_triage.py` `_clean` (line 579, `_CONTROL_RE`) already strips control characters upstream and only a manual `workflow_dispatch` can reach this path.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Run the affected tests (the logic of `.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py`, in CI form) and the static checks that `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs."
  Expected change site: scripts/alert_self_fix.sh, asf_verify
  Evidence of absence: asf_verify runs `bash -n`, Python `compile()` and `yaml.safe_load`, then the trusted pre-push gate (workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py), whose only static checks are ruff and shellcheck (lines 474 and 476). .github/workflows/ci.yml also runs yamllint (`yamllint -s "${files[@]}"`, line 392) and actionlint (Install actionlint, line 475 onward); neither is called in scripts/alert_self_fix.sh. With `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=true` and `.github/workflows/*.yml` a break-glass path, a workflow edit that passes `yaml.safe_load` but fails actionlint can open an auto-merging PR, and break-glass condition 5 runs only `tests/test_*.py`. The issue does not defer this. An earlier reviewer's `ALLOWLIST_EXCEPTIONS` gap claim is wrong, because the entry is present in tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: scripts/alert_self_fix.sh | _asf_compose_body, embedded Python clean(); the control-character `re.sub` is the last substitution
  PROBLEM: Control characters are stripped after the URL and `www.` defangs, so `https:\u0000//github.com/o/r/issues/N`, `#\u000112` or `<!\u0001-- alert-triage:fp=... -->` get past the defangs and are rebuilt (URL auto-close, `#N` reference, or a forged fp marker that `asf_prepare`'s `already_open` jq check would match).
  WHY: Reachable only through a manual `workflow_dispatch`, because `alert_triage.py` `_clean` (line 579, `_CONTROL_RE`) strips these characters upstream. Suggested fix: move the strip to directly after `str()`; optionally drop the leading `\b` in the `https?`/`www.` patterns; 2-4 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/alert_self_fix.sh:clean() in _asf_compose_body, lines 447-456 (current ordering: URL defang then control-character strip) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The control-character strip runs after the URL defang, so `https:\x00//example.com/<owner>/<repo>/issues/9` does not match `r"(?i)\b(https?):/{2}"`, and once the character is stripped the URL is intact and linkable.
  WHY: The auto-close lint passes, and `gh pr merge --auto --squash --match-head-commit <head>` merges the PR, so GitHub closes the unrelated issue. Probability is low. Fix: move the strip to directly after `str(value)`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Run the affected tests (the logic of `.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py`, in CI form) and the static checks that `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs."
  Expected change site: scripts/alert_self_fix.sh, asf_verify
  Evidence of absence: asf_verify runs `bash -n` / `python3 compile()` / `yaml.safe_load()` and the pre-push gate via `scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh`, which runs only ruff and shellcheck. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (lines 381-392, 531-553) also runs YAML lint and actionlint, and neither runs before the self-fix PR opens. Mitigation: CI still gates the squash merge, so the gap is a PR that sits in an invalid state for ~minutes. Suggested fix: add an `actionlint` call in `asf_verify` for changed `.github/workflows/*.yml` files.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: scripts/alert_self_fix.sh | clean() in _asf_compose_body, lines 447-456
  PROBLEM: The control-character strip runs after the URL defang, so a control character inside the protocol prefix gets past the defang.
  WHY: Same as the finding above. Fix: reorder one line. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
